title: Monster East Coast storm leaves hundreds of thousands without power
summary: A major storm along the Eastern Seaboard is bringing heavy rain, strong winds and major coastal flooding on the Thanksgiving holiday. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports from the storm zone in New Jersey.

title: Performers and marching bands scramble after Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade delay
summary: After the historic decision to postpone the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, performers and entire marching bands were forced to scramble to find ways to stay in the New York City area in order to perform during the new parade date on Saturday. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.
